etymology.historical_story: Andie is attested as a personal name, including in the professional name Andie MacDowell. That evidence establishes a naming use, not a Malay dictionary meaning or the origin of this particular token. Without its original sentence or an identified bearer, assigning it a specific ancestry, pronunciation, or historical narrative would be speculative. See [Hallmark’s official profile](https://www.hallmarkchannel.com/cast/andie-macdowell).
